description: This file defines the Blog controller class for the OpenCart admin module, handling CRUD operations and rendering views for the blog module configuration.

classes.name: Blog
classes.description: Controller class for managing the blog module in OpenCart admin, including rendering configuration page and handling CRUD operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the blog module configuration page with breadcrumbs, module info, and view components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the blog module settings, including validation and updating the database.

methods.description: Adds a new blog module instance.

methods.description: Deletes a specified blog module instance.
